nn_architecture: 39-24-24-1 tanh; identical architecture for all windows with unused older history entries set to 0
features: newest-first last L y measurements, last L past actions, prospective candidate u, ahat and ghat; zero padding to 18
notes: M0 regression always uses last 18 past transitions; independent of NN input history
NN weights fixed after training; coefficients ahat,ghat recalculated each simulated step
Model is a synthetic two-temperature thermostat, not an electrohydraulic actuator
All methods use same 9-action discrete educational policy and same disturbance/noise realizations per scenario
Reported bootstrap intervals use only three independent training groups; inferential scope is limited
Closed-loop results do not establish Lyapunov stability or physical safety
